plugin.name: Rascal Debugger
plugin.description:
Works with any Maven-based Rascal project. Installing this plugin is all you need to do: it auto-configures syntax highlighting, editing (diagnostics/completion/CodeLenses), and debugging on its own.
See this repo's own README for details.
plugin.change-notes:
0.1.2
  • Fixed classpath computation (used by both the language server and the debug REPL launcher) failing to find `mvn` when IntelliJ is launched as a GUI app on macOS, which inherits a minimal PATH missing wherever Homebrew/SDKMAN installed Maven.
0.1.1
  • Fixed the plugin's own build: it was silently compiled to Java 25 bytecode regardless of declared compatibility, breaking on any IDE whose own boot JDK was older (e.g. 21). Now correctly targets Java 17.
  • Fixed the bundled TextMate grammar's module rule, which was unreachable and, once reachable, gave real Rascal module bodies no token boundaries.
  • Added macOS support for automatic debug-port discovery (previously Linux-only).
0.1.0
  • Initial release from the plugin's new standalone home (rascal-intellij-debugger-development) -- works with any Maven-based Rascal project.
